items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I played with Jack Carey myself quite a bit, but we never had an organized band, you know. But he would always, as much as possible, pick me to do the job whenever he had one.

ctx.x: I know some people that played with him, you know, but it's hard for me to remember too, because Dave Bailey used to tell me all about that band. Yeah, yeah. And then Punch used to play with him at one time too, both of you. Punch Miller. Yeah.

Yeah, he played with him, he played with him quite a bit. And just, well that's different, he used to trombone player. Jack Carey, Punch Miller played with him quite a bit too. I played with Jack Carey myself quite a bit, but we never had an organized band, you know. But he would always, as much as possible, pick me to do the job whenever he had one.
Well, you know what about the time when you started in the old band, was that in the twenties? Or earlier? I've been, I was trying to remember that. Was it before the Depression, you think?
